overall.verdict: A dense, coherent dark system with a real trust story (green vs violet, receipts, dispute, sovereignty) that already feels like a specialist wallet, not a concept deck. It is not yet a shipping consumer product: jargon, clipped chrome, credit grants inside Swap, and a $155 vs $40 hero split will stall first-timers and treasurers.
priority_fixes: Unify Home with Sovereignty: show spendable vs enforceable in one sentence and one bar; never let $155 look as safe as $40.
Make Pay a 10-second path: labeled scan, compact address, exact fee, one route, sticky Pay button.
Receive as invoices: amount-first, copy link under QR, hide Testnet/inbound-room until Advanced.
Pull credit/collateral extension out of Swap/Assets into an explicit sheet; market swap is quote + Swap.
Give Ravi/Kenji exportable proof (PDF + evidence bundle) and a live dispute window, and stop clipping lists under the tab bar.
